The rope texture appears somewhat smudged and lacks individual fiber definition, looking more like a painted approximation than physical rope.
The elliptical perspective of the pan rim is slightly inconsistent; the curvature near the handle attachment seems subtly flatter than the opposite side, suggesting minor geometric warping.
